**G4AL secrets and player data (see .claude/rules/security.md):**
- MISTRAL_API_KEY or ELEVENLABS_API_KEY hardcoded, logged, printed, put in an error message or sent to the client, even partially beyond key[:4]
- Recorded player audio written to disk, to logs/ or to any file instead of only being sent to Mistral
- Log lines (JSONL in logs/) that include audio bytes or API keys

**G4AL server surface (server/, Flask + Socket.IO):**
- Server bound to 0.0.0.0 or another non-loopback address without an explicit environment opt-in
- Route or Socket.IO handler reading a body without validating required fields, types and ranges (npcId must exist, col/row inside the map)
- /api/audio upload without a size limit, or a bad request answered with a stack trace instead of a 400
- Filesystem path built from request data instead of send_from_directory
- CORS headers on the routes, a wildcard or foreign Socket.IO origin (cors_allowed_origins), or a route that skips the served-origin check, reintroduced
- Route or handler mutating game state outside GameEngine, racing with the game loop thread

**G4AL LLM output (api/interpreter.py):**
- Mistral Voxtral output reaching game/ without being parsed against a schema and the allowed actions (prompt injection through the spoken order)
- Transcript or LLM text rendered in the client through innerHTML or another HTML sink (static/ ui.js, renderer.js)
